{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Display the first few rows of the trial data
display(trial_df.head())

# Check for missing values
missing_values = trial_df.isnull().sum()

# Check data types
dtypes = trial_df.dtypes

# Check unique values in the 'disease_severity' column
unique_disease = trial_df['disease_severity'].unique()

# Check the 'baseline_biomarker' column
baseline_biomarker_col = trial_df['baseline_biomarker']

missing_values, dtypes, unique_disease, baseline_biomarker_col.describe()"}
